obligations.summary: The Commission, in collaboration with Member States, shall set up and maintain an EU database containing information on high-risk AI systems registered under Articles 49 and 60, and AI systems not considered high-risk but registered under Article 6(4) and Article 49, consulting relevant experts and the Board as appropriate.
Providers or, where applicable, their authorised representatives must enter the data listed in Sections A and B of Annex VIII into the EU database.
exceptions: Authorised representative may enter data on behalf of the provider where applicable

obligations.summary: Deployers who are, or who act on behalf of, a public authority, agency or body must enter the data listed in Section C of Annex VIII into the EU database in accordance with Article 49(3) and (4).

Information registered in the EU database under Article 49 must be made accessible and publicly available in a user-friendly, easily navigable, and machine-readable manner, except for sections referred to in Article 49(4) and Article 60(4)(c); information registered under Article 60 shall be accessible only to market surveillance authorities and the Commission unless the provider or prospective provider consents to public access.
exceptions: The section referred to in Article 49(4) and Article 60(4)(c) is excluded from public accessibility
Information registered under Article 60 is restricted to market surveillance authorities and the Commission unless consent for public access is given by the prospective provider or provider

obligations.summary: The EU database shall contain personal data only to the extent necessary for collecting and processing information under this Regulation, limited to names and contact details of natural persons responsible for registering the system and legally authorised to represent the provider or deployer.

The Commission, as controller of the EU database, must provide adequate technical and administrative support to providers, prospective providers, and deployers, and ensure the EU database complies with applicable accessibility requirements.
